description: This file defines the SystemPresenceInfo enum with static methods to fetch system-related information such as the last input time and the primary IPv4 address.

methods.name: lastInputSeconds
methods.description: Returns the number of seconds since the last user input event, or nil if unavailable or invalid.

methods.name: primaryIPv4Address
methods.description: Retrieves the primary IPv4 address via the NetworkInterfaces utility.
